newsitem.title: USA: PECO to shut 1,100 MW Pa. nuke for refuel.
newsitem.headline: PECO to shut 1,100 MW Pa. nuke for refuel.

text.p: PECO Energy Co will shut its 1,100 megawatt (MW) Peach Bottom 2 nuclear unit in Delta, Pa., later today for a 30-day refueling and maintenance outage, the company said Friday.
"It'll be down at three or four o'clock (1500/1600 EDT)," said company spokesman Bill Jones. "It was at 49 percent (of capacity) this morning."
Peachbottom 2, which is refueled every two years, has been in service for 680 days, he said.
The neighboring Peachbottom 3, also at 1,100 MW, was producing at full output, he said.
The Peachbottom units are operated by PECO.
PECO and Public Service Enterprise Group Inc each hold 42.5 percent stakes in Peach Bottom, Atlantic Energy Inc and Delmarva Power & Light Co each hold a 7.5 percent stake in the complex.
